sources.title: GDS September Langfang project implementation announcement
sources.summary: Two unnamed projects entered implementation at a September 11–13 conference. The linked ceremony photo supplies a partial Qihan project label and investor attribution. No exact individual event day, physical construction milestone or numerical campus locator is established.
sources.date_semantics: Conference interval September 11–13; September 14 is publication, not an exact individual project event date.

sources.title: GDS-published ceremony photo with Langfang Qihan project panel
sources.summary: The rightmost visible panel identifies Langfang Qihan and attributes investment/construction to GDS Holdings. The project-name ending is cropped. This is a partial operator/project identity bridge, not a parcel or phase bridge.
sources.date_semantics: Image URL contains September 15 but its upload path is not a status date.

sources.title: Contractor news index links VNET Ulanqab zero-carbon Phase 3 topping-out report
sources.summary: Primary contractor index carries a Phase 3 all-main-structures-topped-out title dated October 5 and links its WeChat article. Article body was not retrieved; captured response is a challenge. October 4 event date appears in secondary reporting only.
sources.date_semantics: October 5 is the index publication date; exact topping-out event day is not confirmed from accessible primary body.

sources.title: VNET Ulanqab zero-carbon Phase 2 labor tender
sources.summary: Names Phase 2 B1 and B2 buildings and associated diesel/gate structures. March 15 start, September 30 completion and October 30 filing are scheduled dates, not observed outcomes. Distinguishes Phase 2 identity from the fresh Phase 3 headline.
sources.date_semantics: February 14 tender; future dates must not be promoted to achieved milestones.

sources.title: Boda reports current Langfang No. 2 Phase 1 service provision
sources.summary: Operator describes Phase 1 providing computing services to leading Internet clients. July 21 supports current-operation confirmation within 90 days, not the original opening date. Campus area and potential compute capability are separately scoped; no phase IT MW is inferred.
sources.date_semantics: July 21 is a dated present-tense operator service report; conference occurred July 17–20. Not an exact opening/commissioning date.

sources.title: Boda northern-campus directory and named Langfang No. 2 Baidu marker
sources.summary: The Langfang No. 2 named slide has data-zuo=116.661689,39.490269 and passes these values unchanged to Baidu BMap.Point. Campus marker only; BD-09 API context is established separately. The page does not publish a WGS84 point.
sources.date_semantics: Undated campus directory; retrieval is not a status observation.

sources.title: Boda reports Qianhai No. 1 current securities-client service
sources.summary: Operator reports a securities company recently moved into Qianhai No. 1 and describes stable ongoing client operations. August 6 is current-operation confirmation, not the exact tenant-entry or opening day. Customer is unnamed.
sources.date_semantics: The entry event is only recently; August 6 is the current service report date.

sources.title: Boda southern-campus directory and named Qianhai No. 1 Baidu marker
sources.summary: Qianhai No. 1 named slide has data-zuo=113.908988,22.520355 and passes it to BMap.Point. This is a parent-campus point with Baidu coordinate semantics; it cannot be copied as WGS84.
sources.date_semantics: Undated directory; not a status observation.

sources.title: VNET announces Zhongwei GW-scale AI data-center collaboration
sources.summary: Operator identifies the Zhongwei initiative and land/planned-power scale, but the inspected announcement does not supply a parcel-specific numeric locator. Announcement and broad regional investment are not completed or current physical construction.
sources.date_semantics: October 12 is publication; no project physical stage/date normalized.

sources.title: Baidu JavaScript API coordinate-system documentation
sources.summary: Official API documentation states external interface coordinates in China use BD09, which differs from GPS/WGS84. This documents the native coordinate context of the Boda BMap markers. No independently verified inverse WGS84 conversion is available in this packet.
